gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-kanchenjunga: Round, unshaded forms with real presence and nothing calligraphic to steer the eye along. But Bellota Text earns its keep big and short, while Kanchenjunga, a sans, keeps a technical drafting-pen line underneath.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-kumbh-sans: Loud, open letterforms with nothing calligraphic to guide the eye, over Kumbh Sans, a sans-serif with terminals cut short. Shrink Bellota Text and its swagger fades fast, so give it room.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Firm, unvarying lines from Bellota Text, with real presence. Below, M PLUS Rounded 1c, a plain sans with terminals that stop short of curling, reads gently paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-meera-inimai: Unshaded and assertive, Bellota Text opens the pair with plenty of presence. Meera Inimai, a plain sans with open-ended curves and a blueprint-lettering feel, keeps paragraphs feeling unhurried and approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-mina: Swagger without shading from Bellota Text, while Mina, a sans, draws strokes plain as a stitched thread outline. Let the heading go large and let Mina stay modest beneath it.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-mooli: Confident, unvarying lines from Bellota Text, while Mooli, a sans, keeps its round letters open and readable. Whole paragraphs stay legible and contemporary, right down to quite small sizes.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-nanum-gothic: Wire-bent s curves that never thin: that's Bellota Text. It earns its keep big and short, with Nanum Gothic, a sans-serif with wide channels into each counter, handling the rest.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Distinctive from the first word, Bellota Text draws its strokes with the steadiness of a drawn string, no shading anywhere. Noto Sans Hatran, a sans-serif with a funnel-wide e, reads smoothly through pages.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-new-tai: Bellota Text lays fine rope-like strokes into open letter shapes, with nothing calligraphic to steer the eye. Big and short suits it; Noto Sans New Tai Lue handles the rest.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-old-sou: Steady, shading-free lines from Bellota Text, word after word. Noto Sans Old South Arabian, a plain sans whose curved strokes end before turning inward, sits quietly under that confident voice.
